title: A running ledger of address-content products read through a positive feature map
summary: Each symbol writes the product of a positive address feature vector and a content vector into a square ledger, and adds the address features to a tally. A later probe reads the ledger with its own positive features and divides by the tally read with the same features, so the result is a weighted mean of earlier contents.
core_idea: Keep a fixed-size ledger of summed address-content products plus a tally of address features, and read both with the probe's features to get a normalized weighted mean of past contents.

state.name: M
state.meaning: Ledger: the sum over earlier positions of the product of the address feature vector (length m) and the content vector (length d).

state.name: z
state.meaning: Tally: the sum of the address feature vectors of every earlier position, used as the divisor of the read.

update.name: features
update.plain: a_t = phi(W_a e_t), c_t = W_c e_t, where e_t = E[x_t] is the embedding of symbol x_t and phi(u) = elu(u) + 1 elementwise, so every feature is positive

readout.name: read
readout.plain: b_t = phi(W_b e_t) are the probe features; y_t = M_t^T b_t / (z_t . b_t), the normalized read

readout.name: symbol
readout.plain: next symbol scores O y_t over the V symbols; the prediction is their argmax

learning.description: Every matrix and offset is learned by gradient descent on the cross-entropy of the next symbol over a training corpus, with backpropagation through the whole sequence.
learning.few_shot_argument: No structure for few examples; about 3000 training sequences are needed for recall of 4 pairs.

complexity.total_sequence: Theta(n m d + n d V)
complexity.constants_notes: One rank-one write of an m by d ledger and one m by d read per symbol, plus the d by V output map. The ledger and tally are m d + m numbers at any length.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Gradient descent with no structure for few examples.

prediction.statement: From random weights, 3000 training sequences of 4 pairs over 16 symbols give recall accuracy 0.99.

capabilities.prediction: Exact recall with hand-set weights when the K address feature vectors are orthogonal, which needs K <= m; beyond m pairs the read mixes contents.

capabilities.task: copy a string after a separator
capabilities.prediction: Exact copying of length L with hand-set position features when L <= m; longer strings are mixed in the ledger.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: A hand-set configuration recalls more than m pairs exactly from an m by d ledger.
The counted operations of the reference code grow faster than linearly in n at fixed m, d and V.

toy_example.description: Two writes into a two by two ledger and one normalized read.
toy_example.python:
import json, math
def phi(u):
    return [x + 1.0 if x > 0 else math.exp(x) for x in u]
M = [[0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0]]
z = [0.0, 0.0]
for a_raw, c in [([0.5, -1.0], [1.0, 0.0]), ([-0.5, 1.0], [0.0, 2.0])]:
    a = phi(a_raw)
    for i in range(2):
        z[i] += a[i]
        for j in range(2):
            M[i][j] += a[i] * c[j]
b = phi([1.0, -1.0])
den = sum(z[i] * b[i] for i in range(2))
y = [sum(M[i][j] * b[i] for i in range(2)) / den for j in range(2)]
print(json.dumps({"read": [round(v, 6) for v in y], "tally": [round(v, 6) for v in z]}))
